name: benzocaine + lidocaine + trolamine
purpose: Uses For temporary pain relief for minor cuts, burns, skin scrapes
uses: For temporary pain relief for minor cuts, burns, skin scrapes Store at temperatures 59°F (15°–30°C)
otcwarn: Warnings For external use only When using this product Do not contact with eyes. Keep out of reach of children If redness, irritation, swelling, or pain persists beyond 7 day, or recurs or if swallowed If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away
